learnings.title: GitHub changelog feed: Issue types and fields are available for personal accounts
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog feed fetched 2026-11-12 lists as newest item: "Issue types and fields are available for personal accounts" (Wed, 11 Nov 2026 17:16:46 +0000). Not independently verified.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: The system plan should review the rollout of issue types and fields for personal accounts to evaluate user impact and documentation updates while taking no direct implementation action.
learnings.next_measurement: Reviewer opens the item link and confirms relevance before promotion.
